hints.title: Digit Separation Order
hints.text: Extract decimal digits of each number from most significant to least significant in the original sequence.

hints.title: String Conversion or Numerical Extraction
hints.text: Convert each integer to its string format or repeatedly divide by powers of 10 to extract digits.

hints.title: List Concatenation
hints.text: Append all digits into a flattened list in sequential arrival order.
